key_insight: Decision-Weighted Flow Matching reweights flow-matching training toward decision-sensitive scenarios, aligning generative modeling with downstream optimization regret instead of only matching distributions.
engineering_relevance: This is useful for systems that generate stochastic inputs for optimization pipelines, because better scenario generation can directly improve operational decisions in finance, transportation, and other risk-aware settings.
method: Uses conditional flow matching as the base generative framework.
Adds endpoint-based decision-sensitive weights to the velocity-regression loss.
Provides a regret-aligned surrogate with theoretical links between pathwise mismatch and downstream regret.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved downstream regret on three CVaR-based contextual stochastic optimization benchmarks: synthetic portfolio, semi-real financial, and traffic-CVaR tasks.
watch_item: The method depends on decision-sensitive weighting and endpoint information, so its effectiveness may hinge on how well these weights are estimated and how transferable they are across optimization problems.
paper_title: Decision-Weighted Flow Matching for Contextual Stochastic Optimization
